explainer.point1: The client pays for the hours up front, so you avoid sending invoices and reminders afterwards.
explainer.point2: When you log time for the client, it is deducted from the package automatically.
explainer.point3: The client can follow the balance in the client portal, and you are notified when the package is running low.
explainer.title: Sell hours in advance with prepaid packages
explainer.intro: A prepaid package is a block of hours the client buys in advance, e.g. 10 hours for recurring tasks and support.
